prompt:
Use case: ui-mockup.
Asset type: high-fidelity native macOS app screen, HEAV3NS-CODE, powered by the LUMI coding agent.
Primary request: User-directed revision. HUMAN–AGENT CONVERSATION is the first-class product; code is supporting evidence. Build a conversation-led workspace, not a VS Code clone. The main central view is always a spacious user-and-agent chat. A narrower RIGHT inspector contains Walkthrough / Changes / Code. Left navigation contains projects and conversations, not a dominant IDE file tree.

Frame: one straight-on complete native app window, fills a 1600x1000 landscape image. No desktop wallpaper, presentation frame, outer annotations, collage, or perspective. Native traffic lights. Exact brand HEAV3NS-CODE; workspace LUMI-NEW.

Composition REQUIRED: left navigation about 220px (14%); CENTER CHAT about 930px (58%); RIGHT inspector about 450px (28%). Divider around x=220 and x=1150. The chat must clearly occupy more than half of the whole image, visually dominant. Composer belongs across the bottom of the CENTER chat only, never in a right sidebar. NO center code editor. NO large editor tabs. No VS Code activity icon rail. No terminal or IDE status bar. Left navigation is a quiet unified source list: LUMI-NEW workspace dropdown, New conversation, Conversations heading, selected Refine sidebar spacing, Explain this project, Review native client; bottom Projects and Account. Simple small familiar line icons with readable labels.

Visual language: retain reference's restrained graphite native material, typography, dividers, blue selection, natural macOS controls. Near-black graphite chat canvas #191d23, sidebar #22262e, inspector #20242b, titlebar #282d35, primary text #edf1f6, secondary #b3becd, restrained blue #3985f5. SF-style system type and compact SF Mono-style code only inside the inspector. Chat body around 19px, generous but disciplined reading rhythm, heading 22px; navigation and inspector labels around 14–16px. Chat is an editorial transcript: modest YOU and LUMI author labels, readable paragraphs, no giant speech bubbles or many nested cards. Supporting evidence is compact and less salient. Native control corners 6–9px, subtle separators, no glow, glass, neon, gradients, mascots, dashboards, or metrics.

Shared header: macOS lights at left, small centered product/workspace title, connection at top right. CENTER header names the conversation and its recorded status. RIGHT header 'Task context' and three tabs 'Walkthrough', 'Changes', 'Code', selected per scene. Inspecting code must not remove or shrink the central conversation. Files and Outline live inside the right Code tab. Hierarchical file nesting, breadcrumbs, line numbers and symbol colors provide IDE clarity without moving the editor to the center.

Composer: large clearly writable region at bottom of CENTER (x=248..1120, y=820..945), top draft text, a small attachment control, quiet 'Using ChatGPT plan · Manage usage' line, action button at bottom right. A compact caption below says 'Enter to send · Shift–Enter for a new line'. Connection/plan status is an illustrative successfully authorized state. All sample content is illustrative, no factual promises.

Product truth: file/code/diff inspection is Read only. Browsing alone does not attach model context. Activity is observable task progress, not private chain of thought. Completion, tests, and human review are distinct. No fake 'tests passed'. No stage, commit, Apply, deploy, debugger, extension store, or terminal. Never show Allow Once as blue or default. Display short supplied copy accurately; no invented claims or performance stats.

Input images: The old v2 reference, if supplied, contributes colors and native material ONLY; discard its editor-centered composition. A conversation-led v3 reference contributes the NEW shared layout and must be kept with the exact same pane hierarchy.

SCENE: Returning to an existing conversation. Left source list prominently supports conversation history: New conversation at top, Today heading, selected Refine sidebar spacing, Explain this project, Earlier heading, Review native client; Projects and Account bottom. Center header 'Refine sidebar spacing' with subtitle 'Previous session · Finished'. Dominant center transcript shows YOU 'Make the navigation easier to scan.' LUMI 'I adjusted the row spacing and section gaps. The changes are saved in this workspace.' Small evidence label 'Checks not run · Not reviewed'. Under a thin divider quiet 'You’re viewing a previous conversation.' Then small normal text 'Continue from here when you’re ready.' Bottom CENTER composer placeholder 'Ask a follow-up…' and Send. RIGHT Walkthrough tab selected, heading 'Previous work', three checked steps 'Inspected workspace files', 'Adjusted navigation spacing', 'Recorded the result'; separate neutral 'Checks not run'. Below 'Files touched', NavigationSidebar.swift and WorkspaceWindow.swift. One small 'View recorded output' button. History selection does not silently resume execution. The chat is the durable shared context; right panel is evidence only. No central session log or code editor.
